items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: we had a remarkable booking agency called the Harold Davison office

ctx.x: I mean the Beatles, you know, we are of an age when that was the popular music at the time that my wife and I were married in 1961. And of course, yeah, its kind of music, and I’m not knocking it at all, I don’t think we were caught up in it at that sense. Because by then, you know, jazz was part of our lives. We were going to see bands, and we were seeing any American visits, because we had, in that late 50s period right through I suppose to maybe the early 70s, we had a remarkable booking agency called the…
